errors.escaped: The dashboard tried to leave its own page and was stopped. Check the dashboard code (HTML).

list.title: Reports

messages.aiNotConfiguredShort: AI is not configured; use a template or a blank dashboard.
messages.aiNotConfigured: AI is not configured. You can create dashboards from ready-made templates or with the HTML editor.
messages.localAiNotConfigured: Local AI is not configured. You can send your request to the connected AI client (Claude, ChatGPT…) or use the ready-made templates.

mine.title: My Dashboards
mine.empty: You have no dashboards yet. Tell the AI what you want to see or pick a template.

shared.title: Shared with Me
shared.empty: No dashboards have been shared with you.

list.description: Dashboards are calculated with current data each time they are opened and refresh themselves while open as the data changes. The Report button on each module's page starts a dashboard with that module's data.

template.title: Create Dashboard from Template
template.description: Ready-made templates do not need AI. The dashboard created is your own copy; it is calculated with current data each time it is opened.

messages.busy: The local model is working, this may take a while…

aiCreate.title: Dashboard with AI
aiCreate.scopeHint: Only this module's data is described to the AI; if the request names another module, that one is added too.

ask.title: What Would You Like to See?

refine.title: Would You Like to Change It?

aiCreate.placeholder: e.g. Number of open issues by company and those past their due date
aiCreate.placeholderRefine: e.g. show companies separately, make the chart monthly
aiCreate.description: The dashboard only works with data you can see. People you share it with see as much as their own permissions allow.

spec.title: Specification Analysis
spec.intro: Draft submittal registers extracted from specification PDFs. For a new analysis, pick a PDF from + Start Specification Analysis above or press Extract Submittal Register from Specification in the Title Block section of the file panel in Documents.

specView.importHint: Creates submittal items from the rows that are not excluded
specView.jsonHint: For transfer to the submittals module
specView.aiClassifyHint: Unclassified items are classified with the local model; item edits are reset.
specView.rebuildHint: Reads the specification again; item edits are reset.
specView.summary: {{pages}}, {{sections}}, {{items}} · This is a draft: correct the type and discipline, remove unnecessary items from the list, then save. Excluded items are left out of exports.

view.liveHint: An open dashboard refreshes itself as the data changes (while the tab is visible).
view.snapshotHint: Save the dashboard as it is now as a PDF (print → save as PDF). The saved dashboard shows current data each time it is opened.
view.dataTime: Data as of {{time}}. Data is calculated with your permissions and always with current records (the latest versions of files, schedules and models); if the data changes while the dashboard is open, it refreshes itself.

broken.manualFix: Fix the query under Edit → Advanced.

proposal.title: Suggested Fix
proposal.hint: Applying it saves a new version of the dashboard; you can go back to the old version with the Versions button.

edit.title: Edit Dashboard
edit.promptHint: Describe the change for the AI
edit.placeholder: e.g. make the chart monthly, do not show closed issues
edit.noAi: AI is not configured; you can edit the dashboard HTML and queries under Advanced.

fields.html: Dashboard HTML (CDE.onData, CDE.bar, CDE.line, CDE.pie, CDE.kpi, CDE.table)

edit.ownerOnly: Only the dashboard's owner can change sharing.

errors.queriesNotArray: Queries must be a JSON array: [{"id": …, "spec": {…}}]
